sar.narrative: On 2016-12-29, transaction 3583368 was executed on card C11923-K2 associated with customer C11923 for the total unauthorized sum of $131.30. The activity was conducted via the online channel utilizing device profile 'SM-G610F Build/NRD90M | chrome 66.0 for android'. Internal fraud investigation anchored on this alert identified anomalous behavioral patterns classified as 'undocumented'. Graph relationship analysis revealed this device hardware profile is simultaneously linked to multiple distinct cards, including C11923-K21363, C05595-K18042, C03938-K19805, indicating an organized syndicate ring. Cardholder contacted regarding the transactions denied authorizing the charges and remained in possession of the card. Total verified fraudulent exposure aggregates to $131.30. Card C11923-K2 has been blocked to prevent further loss, connected instruments have been placed under enhanced monitoring, and this report is filed pursuant to regulatory compliance standards under Bank Policy R2 and 31 CFR 1020.320.
